result_text:
I added `analyzeLandscape` as a second name for `updateLandscape`. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`), but I didn't run any tests or run either command, so the dispatch and the `-help` output are unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`**:
  - New `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` name and description constants. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`.
  - The no-argument overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` ahead of `updateLandscape`, both with the landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names go to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method, so options and behaviour are identical. `-help` prints the usage of whichever name was typed: `analyzeLandscape -help` shows its own description, and `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line" section. It lists `analyzeLandscape` as the documented name and `updateLandscape` as the same command, kept for backward compatibility.

I made no changes to `CLAUDE.md`. A `sed` to update its command list was blocked by the permission prompt and never ran, so it still lists only `updateLandscape`.
